PHASE_0_INSTALL_MULTI_UNIVERSE:
1. Build from an isolated copy of exact required_commit. Do not reset/clean/overwrite an existing checkout.
2. Verify source markers before build:
   - SUPRA/SUPRAOJOHomeView.swift contains enum SUPRAUniverse
   - contains TabView
   - contains cases france, chat, cannonico, missions, runtime, ojo, supra, control
   - routes to FranceOrganismNativeView, SUPRAChatView, ContentView, MissionCenterView, SUPRAProcessObservatoryView, OJOOrganismNativeView, SupraControlCenterView, DecisionInboxView
   - SUPRAChatRuntimeAdapter contains existing bridge recovery label com.novaera.sol-github-bridge
3. Build Release with the proven macOS 26 Xcode pattern and signing disabled during build.
4. Require BUILD SUCCEEDED.
5. Ad-hoc sign and strictly verify the produced SUPRA.app.
6. Preserve the currently canonical installed app as timestamped rollback.
7. Replace only the existing canonical SUPRA installation path already used by the current session; prefer ~/Applications/SUPRA-FRANCE.app if that is the currently installed canonical bundle. Do NOT create a second competing app identity.
8. Launch the exact just-built installed app and verify the launched bundle path.
9. If Accessibility is available, prove visible universe tabs. If not, UI_VISUAL=UNPROVEN is acceptable when build/install/launch/source proof pass.

PHASE_1_TOTAL_REPERTORY_CONSOLIDATION:
Use existing Environment Manager, registries, manifests, freezes, reports, Atlas, Memory, Runtime Discovery and canonical stores FIRST.
Do NOT perform an indiscriminate full-disk rescan when equivalent evidence already exists.
Reconcile and gap-fill the current total iMac repertory:
- hardware / storage / volumes / interfaces / peripherals relevant to compute
- applications / binaries / toolchains / SDKs / package managers / local models
- projects / repositories / archives / freezes / backups
- services / processes / launch agents / schedulers / bridges / workers / listening ports
- databases / caches / configs / logs / observability
- execution channels / runtimes / capability providers
For every object distinguish EXISTS / RUNNING / HEALTHY / CANONICAL / AUTHORIZED.

PHASE_2_TOTAL_MEMORY_CONSOLIDATION:
Recover and reconcile existing:
SUPRA Memory
ojO Memory
CAnnoNico
Canon
Atlas
Project Registry
Capability Registry
Product Registry
Runtime Registry
Authority Registry
ProofGraph
manifests
freezes
decision history
mission history
execution history
learning history
continuity state
world/reality state
conversation-derived memory where locally available and already authorized.
For each record keep identity, source, provenance, timestamp, authority, version, supersession, dependencies, regenerability, evidence, confidence and current use.
Contradictions MUST be registered; never silently overwrite.

PHASE_3_CANNONICO_HARDWARE_SOFTWARE:
Produce or update ONLY existing canonical structures when authority is proven:
TOTAL_IMAC_MANIFEST
TOTAL_MEMORY_CANON
HARDWARE_CANON
SOFTWARE_CANON
RUNTIME_CANON
CAPABILITY_CANON
AUTHORITY_CANON
DEPENDENCY_GRAPH
PROVENANCE_GRAPH
CONTRADICTION_REGISTER
DUPLICATION_REGISTER
CIRCULATION_GRAPH
AUTONOMY_LOOP_REGISTRY
SELF_EVOLUTION_LEDGER
CURRENT_WORLD_STATE

Classify software/assets:
CANONICAL_ACTIVE
CANONICAL_COLD
USEFUL_NONCANONICAL
SUPERSEDED
DUPLICATE
ARCHIVE
EXPERIMENT
UNKNOWN
BLOCKED

UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN without evidence.
No deletion in this mission.

PHASE_4_PYRAMIDE_ALONSO_GATE:
Evaluate each level independently:
L1 FOUNDATION
L2 BUILD / TERMINAL
L3 RUNTIME
L4 MEMORY / INTELLIGENCE / KNOWLEDGE
L5 MISSIONS E2E
L6 EXPERIENCE / HUMAN GATE
L7 AUTONOMY / EXECUTIVE ACTION / SELF-EVOLUTION

A higher level may activate only if required lower levels are PROVEN + STABLE + CONTROLLABLE + RECOVERABLE.
If any level fails: DESCEND_ONE_LEVEL and repair only the smallest proven blocker.
No complexity compensation above a weak foundation.

PHASE_5_CIRCULATION_AND_CIRCULARITY:
Verify the real closed loop:
WORLD
→ OBSERVE
→ EVIDENCE
→ UNDERSTAND
→ DECIDE
→ MISSION
→ AUTHORITY
→ EXECUTE
→ RESULT
→ MEASURE
→ LEARN
→ MEMORY
→ CANNONICO
→ NEXT DECISION
→ WORLD

Find and repair the minimum number of:
DEAD_ENDS
ISOLATED_MEMORY
BROKEN_LINKS
UNUSED_CAPABILITIES
DUPLICATED_PATHS
AUTHORITY_BREAKS
EVIDENCE_BREAKS
RESULTS_NOT_RETURNED_TO_MEMORY
LEARNING_NOT_REUSED

PHASE_6_MULTI_UNIVERSE_CONTRACT:
Maintain ONE SUPRA / ONE CANONICAL TRUTH / MULTIPLE UNIVERSES.
Current universe lanes:
FRANCE
CHAT
CANNONICO
MISSIONS
RUNTIME
OJO
SUPRA
CONTROL

Each universe MAY have its own:
visual identity
local working context
mission queue
tools/capabilities subset
presentation
operational loop

No universe may own a conflicting canonical truth.
All useful results circulate back through evidence → memory → CAnnoNico.

PHASE_7_AUTONOMY_READINESS:
AUTONOMY_READY=YES only if:
- required Alonso levels pass
- canonical authority is coherent
- rollback exists
- circulation closes
- no unresolved critical contradiction blocks execution

If AUTONOMY_READY=NO:
do not start global autonomy.
Repair only NEXT_MINIMAL_REPAIR and re-evaluate.

PHASE_8_ACTIVATE_EXISTING_AUTONOMOUS_LOOPS_ONLY_IF_READY:
Do NOT recreate loops.
Recover existing loops and activate progressively:
FOUNDATION
→ BUILD
→ RUNTIME
→ MEMORY/KNOWLEDGE
→ MISSIONS E2E
→ EXPERIENCE
→ AUTONOMY/SELF-EVOLUTION

For each loop require:
START=PASS
HEALTH=PASS
USEFUL_WORK=PROVEN
REAL_RESULT=PROVEN
EVIDENCE_RETURNED=YES
LEARNING_RETURNED_TO_MEMORY=YES
ROLLBACK=AVAILABLE
NO_REGRESSION=YES

Do not activate a higher layer when a lower required layer is degraded.

PHASE_9_CONTROLLED_AUTOEVOLUTION:
Self-evolution starts only from a real observed limitation:
REAL_OPERATION
→ REAL_RESULT
→ LEARNING
→ REAL_LIMIT
→ MINIMAL_NECESSARY_IMPROVEMENT
→ TEST
→ PROOF
→ NO_REGRESSION
→ RESUME_REAL_OPERATION

Forbidden:
self-modification without demonstrated need
self-promotion without proof
silent canonical authority change
destructive cleanup
new generic engines/bridges/runtimes when an equivalent exists

HUMAN_GATE_REQUIRED_FOR:
irreversible deletion
loss of patrimony
security boundary change
canonical authority reassignment
external/public publication
financial commitment
high-impact real-world action
